notes: I replaced the hard piecewise-cubic (which overpredicted magnitude near zero, e.g. E4/E6 at x=0.1–0.8) with a smooth blend: a cubic fit to the near-zero data and a cubic fit to the far data, gated by a tanh in |x| so the near-zero behavior dominates for small |x| and the far cubic takes over for large |x|. This matches E6's intermediate values much better while preserving the accurate large-|x| be
